title: Grateful Dead Live at Studio- Wake of the Flood Outtakes on 1973-08-01
venue: Studio- Wake of the Flood Outtakes
lineage: Betty Cantor reels > PCM >  DAT > DIO 2448 > SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard outtakes with crisp, clean audio and standout performances of Stella Blue, Weather Report Suite, Row Jimmy and Let It Grow.
ai_review.review: The archive collection delivers studio‑quality mixes that many reviewers call “superb”, “crisp” and “clean”.  Highlights include the emotive vocal harmonies on Stella Blue, a sparkling Weather Report Suite, Jerry’s soaring solos on Row Jimmy and Let It Grow, and strong rhythm work from Bob Weir.  Overall the material is praised as an essential glimpse into the mid‑70s Dead era.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 30 reviews overwhelmingly rate the release 5 stars, praising both performance and audio fidelity; only a few unrelated low‑star posts exist.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers repeatedly describe the sound as crisp, clean, studio‑mix quality with no noticeable dropouts or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A curated set of outtakes that showcases the band’s stylistic breadth in 1973, flowing from soulful ballads to jazzy suites and blues‑rock jams.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for emotive solos (Row Jimmy, Let It Grow), pedal‑steel texture, and overall guitar brilliance.
band_member_comments.Phil: Brief mention of possible vocal harmonies; otherwise no specific bass commentary.
band_member_comments.Bob: Highlighted as delivering “one of the best rhythm guitar players on wheels” with standout work on Row Jimmy.
band_member_comments.Keys: Several reviewers note Keith’s unexpected vocal harmonies on Stella Blue and Here Comes Sunshine, describing his voice as confident and pleasant.
